headlines.title: Diamondback Energy (FANG) Makes A $5 Billion Midland Basin Bet
headlines.summary: Diamondback Energy (NasdaqGS:FANG) agreed to acquire Double Eagle’s Midland Basin assets for US$5b, expanding its Permian position. The deal brings a larger drilling inventory and additional Midland Basin acreage into Diamondback Energy’s portfolio. Management describes the acquisition as immediately accretive and a key step in reshaping Diamondback’s production and asset mix.

headlines.title: On Monday in Oil and Gas, Federal Hormuz Data Lands as Two Acquisitions Are Announced
headlines.summary: Oil Market Daily News Commentary - Oil prices fell on Monday, Reuters reported, citing signs that oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz are recovering, which it said reinforced expectations of surplus supply. The same day, the U.S. Energy Information Administration published new quarterly figures on oil moving through the strait, a tanker transiting it outbound reported being struck, and two North American producers announced acquisitions.

description: Diamondback Energy, Inc., an independent oil and natural gas company, acquires, develops, explores, and exploits unconventional, onshore oil and natural gas reserves in the Permian Basin in West Texas, the United States. The company primarily focuses on the development of the Spraberry and Wolfcamp formations of the Midland Basin; and the Wolfcamp and Bone Spring formations of the Delaware Basin, both of which are part of the Permian Basin in West Texas and New Mexico. Diamondback Energy, Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Midland, Texas.
